name: Live with Jill Count
source:
Jill has had moderate success as a streamer, and to mix things up, this Halloween she is going to life-stream a visit to a haunted hospital. The twist? It's actually haunted.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/745760/Perceptions_of_the_Dead/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
吉尔作为主播已经取得了一定的成功，而更糟糕的是，今年万圣节她将现场直播参观一家闹鬼的医院。转折？它实际上是闹鬼的。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/745760/Perceptions_of_the_Dead/]Steam[/url]]
